generateCommentActions.temperatureReason: Conditional asynchronous child of the hot create-comment path; keeping it HOT avoids a hidden hot-to-cold transition when the existing AI feature is enabled.
generateCommentActions.reason: The bounded branch hands the run to generateCommentActionsBounded; the original off body remains literal. The bounded body keeps every literal step and replaces only its two broad reads (installed existence probe plus BeginIssueBootstrapRead's paged projection; raw development viewer/role) and its two writes, which keep their callbacks and discussion scope but are declared to the closed comment action writer: the claim stamps only the selected comment, the append adds only the declared proposals after every native action, with commentActionsAllowed and validateCommentAction's closure selected inside the transaction. TestScaleP21CommentActionGenerationDifferential and TestScaleP21CommentActionClaimRaceDifferential compare legacy, warm and SQL-reloaded runs byte for byte (narrow inputs on and off): prompt requests, claims, appends, stored rows, metadata and installed images, events, webhooks and realtime, for proposal mixes, claim races (stamped, rewritten, missing comment, turned-off setting), changes between claim and append (comment body/version, setting, existing action, archived issue) and a parent-only grant. Persistent SQLite twice and race pass with zero full decodes and released work.

listCommentActions.reason: The bounded branch composes the proven optional issue validation headers, current actor settings and independently owned raw action/validation selectors; its original off body remains literal. SW153 compares the actual alias route across five principal classes and four credentials plus status/version/filter/raw-generation cases, preserving accepted-action bypass, duplicates, other target users, initialized empty output and the earlier issue handoff versus fresh raw validation source. SW152/SW154 separately prove warm/reloaded/unknown source fidelity, cancellation, quotas, ownership, persistent SQLite twice and race. No action executes here; generation and resolve retain separate guards.
listCommentActions.temperatureReason: Issue ActivityTimeline mounts useCommentActions and loads this endpoint on issue view/comment changes, including when actions are unavailable.

resolveCommentAction.temperatureReason: Issue activity action acceptance performs an issue update; it is part of the same issue-comment UI flow.
resolveCommentAction.reason: The bounded branch declares the resolution (issue, action, status) on the original scope (the issue, its status-automation family, issue creation) and callback; the off path is literal. The resource-scope image writer runs it with a closed profile: the status-automation family and the issue sequence are resolved inside the record transaction exactly as loadScopedIssues does, the callback sees the authorization closure, every action with the resolved ID (first issue match, with ordinals), and for an accepted pending action the literal update closure (status/assignee/priority/labels: the batch update inputs) or the sub-issue creation closure (the issue creation inputs); a link only appends. Validation admits the resolved action, SLAs, SLA events, suggestions and creation side records; each is patched at its native ordinal and committed with the issue, content and event rows in one transaction. TestScaleP21CommentActionResolutionDifferential compares legacy, warm and SQL-reloaded runs (narrow inputs on and off) byte for byte, including the response, stored rows, metadata, installed images, event, webhook previous values and realtime: accepted priority/status/assignee/labels/link/sub-issue, dismissals, idempotent and conflicting re-resolution, stale and invalid proposals, missing actions and comments, a duplicate action ID on another issue, a turned-off setting and a sub-issue creation failure that rolls back the whole resolution. Persistent SQLite twice and race pass with zero full decodes and released work.

startCommentActions.reason: The bounded branch reuses owned issue authorization/current settings, preserving bounded-handoff priority and caller-owned legacy data handoffs, then retains the original asynchronous launch block. The original off body remains literal. SW153 compares the synchronous production gate tuple against the literal old gate for positive actors and preference/credential/app/bot/via/archive refusals, and executes denied starts without invoking a model. The callback captures only the original workspace/actor/IDs; generation, its slot wait and writer remain independently guarded. SW152/SW154 prove the newly composed shared primitives once.
startCommentActions.temperatureReason: Successful issue-comment creation calls this helper, and it reads workspaceData before testing the optional AI policy.
